headline: Democratic Senator Schumer accuses Nvidia CEO of violating U.S. export control law
summary: Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer accused Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang of violating federal law limiting exports of advanced technology to China.
why: Nvidia designs the AI chips that are central to data-center spending, and US export rules on advanced chips to China directly affect its China sales.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The accusation concerns the company's compliance with US export controls on advanced technology to China.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Senador demócrata Schumer acusa al CEO de Nvidia de violar la ley de control de exportaciones de EU
